@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The actress has appeared in more than twenty films, and she has finally been n______ed for the best actress award this year.
= nominated
~詞義 nominate（v.）提名
~原文 The actress has appeared in more than twenty films, and she has finally been nominated for the best actress award this year.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: It was Roger's first time participating in this tennis t______t, and he got fourth place.
= tournament
~詞義 tournament（n.）錦標賽
~原文 It was Roger's first time participating in this tennis tournament, and he got fourth place.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: There is an increasing number of j______e crime cases in the region, which is a worrying trend for both parents and schools.
= juvenile
~詞義 juvenile（adj.）青少年的
~原文 There is an increasing number of juvenile crime cases in the region, which is a worrying trend for both parents and schools.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: R______m continues to harm society by creating hatred and denying people opportunities they rightfully deserve.
= Racism
~詞義 racism（n.）種族主義
~原文 Racism continues to harm society by creating hatred and denying people opportunities they rightfully deserve.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Frank's unusual behavior a______ed his wife's suspicions, and she demanded an explanation from him.
= aroused
~詞義 arouse（v.）激起
~原文 Frank's unusual behavior aroused his wife's suspicions, and she demanded an explanation from him.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Debbie's parents showed clear ______ when she announced her plan to drop out of college.
A: disapproval
B: spouse
C: prophecy
D: prosecution
= A
~詞義 disapproval（n.）不贊同
~原文 Debbie's parents showed clear disapproval when she announced her plan to drop out of college.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: We have a lot of unused tools stored in the back of the ______. We should clear them out sometime.
A: directory
B: doctrine
C: quota
D: warehouse
= D
~詞義 warehouse（n.）倉庫
~原文 We have a lot of unused tools stored in the back of the warehouse. We should clear them out sometime.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Scientists hold different views toward the practice of ______ modification. Some believe that it may ruin the natural ecosystem.
A: articulate
B: ethical
C: envious
D: genetic
= D
~詞義 genetic（adj.）基因的
~原文 Scientists hold different views toward the practice of genetic modification. Some believe that it may ruin the natural ecosystem.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Judy is working hard toward her goal of achieving financial ______, but it may still take her a few years to make it.
A: negotiation
B: narrative
C: stability
D: traitor
= C
~詞義 stability（n.）穩定性
~原文 Judy is working hard toward her goal of achieving financial stability, but it may still take her a few years to make it.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Lily went to a ______ to protest the use of nuclear power on Saturday. She cares deeply about the environment.
A: racism
B: rally
C: raid
D: rack
= B
~詞義 rally（n.）集會
~原文 Lily went to a rally to protest the use of nuclear power on Saturday. She cares deeply about the environment.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: arrogance
B: nominee
C: gasped
D: jury
E: squashed
F: whatsoever

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: David has no interest ______ in literature. He reads only nonfiction books.
= F
~詞義 whatsoever（adv.）絲毫
~原文 David has no interest whatsoever in literature. He reads only nonfiction books.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The audience ______ during the intense scene, which really came as a great surprise at that point in the movie.
= C
~詞義 gasp（v.）倒抽氣
~原文 The audience gasped during the intense scene, which really came as a great surprise at that point in the movie.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: The audience found the speaker's ______ unbearable, and it was difficult for them to appreciate his otherwise valuable message.
= A
~詞義 arrogance（n.）傲慢
~原文 The audience found the speaker's arrogance unbearable, and it was difficult for them to appreciate his otherwise valuable message.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The boy didn't see the small snail on the ground, and he accidentally ______ it.
= E
~詞義 squash（v.）擠壓
~原文 The boy didn't see the small snail on the ground, and he accidentally squashed it.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The lawyer seems to have convinced the ______; it is likely that they will decide in favor of the defendant.
= D
~詞義 jury（n.）陪審團
~原文 The lawyer seems to have convinced the jury; it is likely that they will decide in favor of the defendant.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: confidential
B: confine
C: weird
D: ethic
E: squad
F: wary

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: The movie's ______ ending confused many viewers and made them unsure how to interpret the final scene.
= C
~詞義 weird（adj.）怪異的
~原文 The movie's weird ending confused many viewers and made them unsure how to interpret the final scene.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The fire department sent a(n) ______ into the burning building to evacuate the residents.
= E
~詞義 squad（n.）小隊
~原文 The fire department sent a(n) squad into the burning building to evacuate the residents.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Be ______ of giving out your personal information; you may fall prey to scammers.
= F
~詞義 wary（adj.）謹慎的
~原文 Be wary of giving out your personal information; you may fall prey to scammers.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: What I am about to tell you is strictly ______. Do not repeat it to anyone.
= A
~詞義 confidential（adj.）機密的
~原文 What I am about to tell you is strictly confidential. Do not repeat it to anyone.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: It is cruel of the owners to ______ their pets to cages for long periods of time. The animals need the freedom to move about.
= B
~詞義 confine（v.）監禁
~原文 It is cruel of the owners to confine their pets to cages for long periods of time. The animals need the freedom to move about.
